name: Starnheim
description: Starnheim is one of the ten realms of Kaldheim, at the top of the World Tree, the source of the plane's light and the home of the Valkyries and the honored dead.

description_citations.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

summary.text: Starnheim is one of the ten realms of Kaldheim, at the top of the World Tree, the source of the plane's light and the home of the Valkyries and the honored dead.

citations.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

bio.text: Heroes of every clan feast there for all time, and the Valkyries take the gloriously dead there, as with Thura, who joined the honored dead.

bio.text: Niko Aris became the first mortal to arrive, travelling through an Omenpath guided by Orhaft's magic, and warned the Valkyries that Koma was coming.

status.text: Starnheim stands as the realm of heroes, having repelled Koma, and its latest mention shows the path to it opening and vengeance raining down on Bretagard's enemies.

citations.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Hailstorm Valkyrie (Kaldheim, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Through an Omenpath guided by Orhaft and the Valkyrie's magic, Niko leaps onto a skiff and arrives at the docks of Starnheim.
timeline.quote: The skiff bumped against a vast network of docks that disappeared into the kind of light that sings of home.

citation.work: Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing
citation.text: "Know Which Way the Wind Is Blowing" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko arrives at Starnheim's docks, enters its warm, welcoming hall, and senses it is home.
timeline.quote: Starnheim was home.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko joins the feasting dead, meeting Thura Sail-Rend, Gæller No-breath and Vígniút and telling of defying destiny.
timeline.quote: Niko Aris, they of Meletis,

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Following a cat, Niko enters a hall of Valkyries who dismiss them as a lost visitor.
timeline.quote: You should return to the feast.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko delivers the warning that the Cosmos Serpent is coming, and the Valkyries refuse to believe Starnheim can be attacked.
timeline.quote: the Cosmos Serpent is coming for you.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Avtyr arrives and accuses Niko of interrupting a Valkyrie judgement, but Niko reveals the limits of the mirror trap and the Valkyries accept it.
timeline.quote: You were never in danger from me.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Koma tears into the sky above Starnheim from the Cosmos and the Valkyries panic.
timeline.quote: The creature solidified into a massive, armored eel, born from the interstices of the Cosmos itself.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko proposes luring Koma like a cat chasing toys back out through an Omenpath; Avtyr and Rytva agree.
timeline.quote: Fly in close, right side or left side—make it chase you the way cats chase toys.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Forty Valkyries take to the air, and Niko lands on Koma's neck to anchor a javelin at its skull.
timeline.quote: They slid down the last few feet of neck to bury their spear between the scales of Koma's skull.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Valkyries bait Koma while Niko's mirror traps hide their bodies, steering Koma along.
timeline.quote: The serpent's jaws clamped down on nothing but clouds.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko spots the right Omenpath, an open portal of flame and battle, and directs the last Valkyrie squad to draw Koma toward it.
timeline.quote: THERE!" Niko shouted, raising their left fist.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Koma crashes through the hole and falls out of Starnheim, and Niko is nearly pulled in.
timeline.quote: Koma's weight and momentum carried it the rest of the way down through the hole

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Niko lets go, but Avtyr catches them and flies down with them into the battle as Valkyries follow.
timeline.quote: Avtyr's hand clamped around their wrist.

citation.text: "Aim Through the Target" by Setsu Uzumé. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: With the Sword of the Realms, Tibalt cuts open a doorway to Starnheim and unleashes Koma on the Valkyries.
timeline.quote: he cut open a doorway to the home of the Valkyries, where the Cosmos Serpent could make up for lost time

citation.text: "Episode 3: The Saga of Tibalt" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Njala seeks out the skald Hormgart in Starnheim to learn about Arni.
timeline.quote: She found Hormgart deep into his cups

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: Hormgart begins the tale of how Arni, once called Goatleaper, got his new name (a story told in flashback).
timeline.quote: He was called Goatleaper, once,

citation.text: "Brokenbrow" by Roy Graham, Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jan 2021.

timeline.summary: The path to Starnheim opened and vengeance rained down on Bretagard's enemies.
timeline.quote: When the path to Starnheim was opened, vengeance rained down upon the enemies of Bretagard.

citation.text: Hailstorm Valkyrie (Kaldheim, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Niko warns the Valkyries and helps drive Koma back through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Niko took charge and helped them to drive Koma back through the Omenpath it had entered.

citation.text: "Niko Aris", section "Kaldheim". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko Aris arrives at Starnheim and sees a radiant plane atop black mirror-like waters.
timeline.quote: When Niko Aris arrived at Starnheim, they saw a mostly radiant plane as if before dawn, atop black mirror-like waters.

citation.text: "Starnheim", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the chaos instigated by Tibalt, Koma attacks Starnheim and Niko joins the valkyries in its defense.
timeline.quote: Starnheim was attacked by the the Cosmos serpent Koma and Niko joined a host of valkyries in defense of the realm.

citation.text: "Starnheim", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko journeys through an Omenpath into Starnheim, guided by Orhaft's magic and trapped Avtyr.
timeline.quote: no mortal had ventured into the realm of Starnheim before

citation.text: "Avtyr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko warns the Valkyries about Koma; Avtyr accuses Niko of disrupting Kaldheim's balance, then Koma breaks through.
timeline.quote: especially Avtyr who accused Niko of disrupting Kaldheim's balance

citation.text: "Avtyr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko, Rytva and Avtyr use mirrors and illusions to redirect Koma back through the portals.
timeline.quote: They orchestrated a risky strategy involving mirrors and illusions

citation.text: "Avtyr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko and Avtyr drive Koma back through a closing portal, sacrificing the stability of Starnheim's dock.
timeline.quote: The climax saw Niko and Avtyr collaborating in a final, daring maneuver

citation.text: "Avtyr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: For centuries Egon tries to force his way into Starnheim and is stopped by Firja and Ranar.
timeline.quote: Egon is stopped by Firja and the warrior spirit Ranar

citation.text: "Egon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Njala sought out Hormgart in Starnheim to learn about Arni Brokenbrow.
timeline.quote: the Valkyrie shepherd Njala sought out Hormgart to learn more about Arni Brokenbrow

citation.text: "Hormgart", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tibalt used the Sword of the Realms to open an Omenpath for Koma into Starnheim.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Tibalt used the Sword of the Realms and opened an Omenpath for Koma to enter the realm

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Valkyries, helped by Niko Aris, repelled Koma from Starnheim.
timeline.quote: The Serpent was repelled from Starnheim by the Valkyries with the help of the planeswalker Niko Aris .

citation.text: "Koma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Njala seeks out Hormgart, who explains how Arni earned the name Brokenbrow headbutting a troll.
timeline.quote: She sought out Hormgart, a dwarf skald in Starnheim, to learn more about Arni.

citation.text: "Njala", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Orhaft agrees to help and guides a ship carrying Niko through an Omenpath into Starnheim.
timeline.quote: Orhaft guided a ship carrying Niko through an Omenpath

citation.text: "Orhaft Stoneback", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko journeyed through an Omenpath to Starnheim, where no mortal had ventured before.
timeline.quote: no mortal had ventured into the realm of Starnheim before

citation.text: "Rytva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko warned the Valkyries about Koma; Koma then breached into Starnheim.
timeline.quote: Koma manifested, breaching through the fabric of reality itself

citation.text: "Rytva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko, Rytva and Avtyr devised a plan using mirrors and illusions to redirect Koma through the portals.
timeline.quote: They orchestrated a risky strategy involving mirrors and illusions

citation.text: "Rytva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Niko and Avtyr drove Koma back through a closing portal, sacrificing the stability of Starnheim's dock.
timeline.quote: drive Koma back through a closing portal, sacrificing the stability of Starnheim's dock

citation.text: "Rytva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Valkyries claim Thura's soul and confer her titles; she enters Starnheim.
timeline.quote: Thura's soul was claimed by the Valkyries

citation.text: "Thura", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thura feasts, banters and drinks with Vígniút, Gæller No-breath and others in Starnheim.
timeline.quote: sharing drinks and tales with Vígniút, Gæller No-breath, and others

citation.text: "Thura", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
